items.description:
# Audio Recorder Engine V2

**Capture high-quality microphone audio with flexible recording modes and automation-ready output.**

Audio Recorder Engine is a professional recording engine for **Core Factory V2** that allows you to capture audio directly from any available microphone and save it as high-quality WAV files.

Designed for automation as well as manual recording, the engine supports one-time recordings, countdown recording, and scheduled recording cycles, making it suitable for voiceovers, podcasts, interviews, AI datasets, meeting notes, testing, and production workflows.

---

# Key Features

## High-Quality Audio Recording

Record directly from your microphone with configurable audio settings.

Supported options include:

* Mono or Stereo recording
* Multiple sample rates
* Multiple PCM formats
* Custom input buffer size
* WAV output format

Produce clean, uncompressed audio suitable for editing, transcription, or AI processing.

---

## Multiple Recording Modes

Choose the recording workflow that best fits your needs.

### Manual Mode

Start recording after an optional countdown, giving you time to prepare before capture begins.

### One-Time Recording

Automatically record for a predefined duration and stop when finished.

Ideal for interviews, voice notes, and quick recordings.

### Cycle Recording

Automatically perform repeated recordings at fixed time intervals.

Perfect for:

* Environmental monitoring
* Scheduled voice capture
* Automated testing
* Long-term recording tasks

---

## Flexible Audio Configuration

Configure recording parameters to match your project requirements.

Available settings include:

* Recording duration
* Countdown timer
* Recording interval
* Maximum recording cycles
* Sample rate
* Audio channels
* PCM sample format
* Input block size
* Output filename template

---

## Microphone Device Selection

Select either:

* The system default microphone
* A specific recording device
* A device index
* A device name

The engine automatically validates microphone availability before recording begins to prevent failed jobs.

---

## Smart Output Management

Generate organized recordings with customizable filenames.

Features include:

* Timestamp-based filenames
* Date and time variables
* Optional overwrite protection
* Automatic output folder opening
* Structured execution results

---

## Automation Ready

Audio Recorder Engine integrates seamlessly with **Core Factory V2 Pipelines**.

Captured audio can be passed directly into downstream engines for:

* Speech-to-Text
* AI Transcription
* Translation
* Audio Analysis
* Content Generation
* Meeting Summaries
* Voice Processing
* Dataset Preparation

No manual file handling is required.

---

# Typical Use Cases

* Podcast recording
* Voice-over production
* AI speech datasets
* Meeting recordings
* Interview capture
* Voice memos
* Audio testing
* Accessibility workflows
* Automated monitoring
* Research projects

---

# Reliable Recording

Designed for dependable operation during both manual and automated workflows.

Features include:

* Recording progress reporting
* Cancellation support
* Input device validation
* Stable worker-process execution
* Structured execution logs
* Machine-readable results for Pipelines

---

# System Requirements

* Core Factory V2
* Windows-compatible audio input device
* A working microphone
* SoundDevice audio runtime

---

# Why Choose Audio Recorder Engine?

Most recording applications focus on manual audio capture.

Audio Recorder Engine goes further by combining professional recording capabilities with automation, scheduling, and seamless integration into larger workflows.

Whether you're building AI datasets, recording voice content, automating repetitive audio capture, or creating production pipelines, Audio Recorder Engine provides a reliable and scalable recording solution inside the Core Factory V2 ecosystem.

---

## Perfect For

* Content Creators
* Podcasters
* AI Developers
* Researchers
* Software Testers
* Business Teams
* Educators
* Anyone who needs reliable microphone recording with automation support

Capture once, schedule forever, and integrate every recording into your automated workflows with Audio Recorder Engine V2.

items.title: File Organization Engine V2
items.description:
# File Organization Engine V2

**Rename thousands of files and organize entire folders in minutes.**

File Organization Engine is a powerful automation engine for **Core Factory V2** that helps you clean up messy folders, standardize filenames, and automatically organize files into structured directories.

Whether you're managing media libraries, project assets, downloaded files, engineering documents, or large datasets, this engine eliminates repetitive manual work with safe, repeatable automation.

---

# Key Features

## Batch File Renaming

Rename hundreds or thousands of files in a single operation.

Supported methods include:

* Simple Base Name
* Custom Filename Templates
* Automatic Numbering
* Find & Replace
* Regular Expression (Regex)
* Letter Case Conversion
* Configurable Number Padding

Example:

```
IMG_8391.jpg
IMG_8392.jpg
IMG_8393.jpg

↓

Vacation_001.jpg
Vacation_002.jpg
Vacation_003.jpg
```

---

## Smart Folder Organization

Automatically organize files into structured folders.

Supported organization modes:

* By File Extension
* By Year
* By Month
* By First Letter

Example:

```
Downloads/

↓

Images/
Videos/
Documents/
Archives/
```

or

```
Photos/

↓

2026/
   January/
   February/
   March/
```

---

## Recursive Processing

Process an entire directory tree with a single operation.

The engine can automatically include subfolders, making it ideal for organizing large projects without manually selecting each folder.

---

## Safe Preview Mode

Preview every planned operation before making any changes.

Dry Run mode lets you verify rename and organization results without modifying your files.

Perfect for large collections where safety is important.

---

## Flexible Rename Rules

Choose the naming style that fits your workflow.

Supported options include:

* Sequential numbering
* Original filename tokens
* File extension tokens
* Search & Replace
* Regex patterns
* Uppercase / Lowercase conversion

---

## Reliable Batch Processing

Designed for large-scale automation.

Features include:

* Continue on Error
* Progress Reporting
* Filename Conflict Handling
* Structured Execution Reports
* Pipeline Integration

The engine continues processing remaining files even if individual items fail (when enabled).

---

# Typical Use Cases

* Organize Download folders
* Rename camera photos
* Standardize engineering documents
* Prepare AI training datasets
* Clean up project assets
* Organize media libraries
* Archive completed projects
* Prepare files for cloud storage

---

# Pipeline Ready

File Organization Engine integrates directly with **Core Factory V2 Pipelines**.

It is commonly used before engines such as:

* File Transfer
* Image Processing
* OCR
* AI Analysis
* Metadata Processing
* Upload Automation

Its structured output makes it easy to build reliable multi-step automation workflows.

---

# Why Choose File Organization Engine?

Manually renaming and organizing files is repetitive, slow, and prone to mistakes.

File Organization Engine automates the entire process while giving you complete control over naming rules, folder structures, and execution behavior.

Whether you're managing hundreds or hundreds of thousands of files, the engine provides a fast, safe, and repeatable way to keep everything organized.

---

## Perfect For

* Content Creators
* Photographers
* Engineers
* AI Developers
* Media Teams
* Businesses
* Archivists
* Anyone managing large collections of files

Save hours of manual work by transforming chaotic folders into clean, consistent, and well-organized file libraries with just a few clicks.

items.name: File Transfer Engine V2
items.title: File Transfer Engine V2
items.description:
# File Transfer Engine V2

Move and organize large collections of files safely and automatically.

The **File Transfer Engine** is a high-performance automation engine for **Core Factory V2**, designed to move files from one location to another while intelligently organizing them into structured folders. It is ideal for users who regularly manage media libraries, downloaded assets, project files, or large datasets.

Unlike a basic file mover, this engine can automatically classify files into **Video**, **Image**, and **Other** categories, preserve the original folder hierarchy, filter short videos, resolve filename conflicts, and generate detailed execution reports for use inside automation pipelines.

---

## Key Features

* Move files and folders with high performance
* Recursive processing of entire directory trees
* Automatically classify files into:

  * Video
  * Image
  * Other
* Preserve original folder structure
* Filter videos by duration
* Process only short videos or exclude them
* Intelligent filename conflict handling

  * Rename
  * Overwrite
  * Skip
* Detailed execution report and processing log
* Progress reporting for long-running jobs
* Supports cancellation during execution
* Fully compatible with Core Factory V2 Pipelines

---

## Typical Use Cases

* Organize downloaded media collections
* Prepare datasets for AI training
* Clean up mixed folders containing images, videos, and documents
* Archive completed projects
* Build structured media libraries
* Batch organize thousands of files before further processing
* Prepare input folders for downstream Core Factory engines

---

## Engine Settings

The engine provides configurable options including:

* Recursive folder scanning
* Preserve folder hierarchy
* Video duration filtering
* File conflict policy
* Continue on error
* Dry Run mode (simulation)
* Include and exclude filename patterns

These settings allow the engine to adapt to both simple and enterprise-scale workflows.

---

## Pipeline Ready

File Transfer Engine integrates seamlessly with the Core Factory V2 automation system.

It can be used as the first stage of a processing pipeline before engines such as:

* Media Analysis
* Media Transcode
* Split & Merge
* Watermark
* AI Processing
* Upload Automation

Each execution produces structured output and reports that can be consumed directly by downstream pipeline stages.

---

## System Requirements

* Core Factory V2
* Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
* FFprobe (required only when using video duration filtering)

---

## License

A valid Core Factory V2 license is required to unlock the full version.

Trial mode is supported according to the current Core Factory licensing policy.

---

## Why Choose File Transfer Engine?

Managing thousands of files manually is slow, repetitive, and error-prone.

File Transfer Engine automates the entire workflow with reliable, repeatable, and pipeline-ready processing—making it an essential utility for content creators, AI developers, media professionals, and anyone working with large collections of files every day.

items.title: Media Analysis Engine V2
items.description:
# Media Analysis Engine V2

**Analyze, verify, and understand your files before taking action.**

Media Analysis Engine is a professional analysis engine for **Core Factory V2** that scans files and folders to detect duplicates, generate secure file hashes, verify file integrity, build complete inventories, and produce detailed filesystem statistics.

Instead of blindly processing files, this engine gives you a complete understanding of your media and document collections, making it the perfect first step in any automation pipeline.

---

# Key Features

## Duplicate File Detection

Quickly identify duplicate files across one or multiple folders.

Features include:

* Detect exact duplicates
* Fast size-first comparison
* SHA-256 verification
* Configurable duplicate handling
* Structured duplicate reports

Choose how duplicates should be handled:

* Report only
* Move duplicates
* Delete duplicates

You also decide which copy should be preserved:

* First discovered
* Newest file
* Oldest file

---

## Secure File Hashing

Generate digital fingerprints for files using industry-standard hash algorithms.

Supported algorithms include:

* SHA-256
* SHA-1
* MD5

Hash reports are ideal for:

* Data integrity verification
* Digital archives
* AI datasets
* Compliance workflows
* File tracking

---

## File Integrity Verification

Compare existing files against previously generated hash manifests.

Quickly determine whether files have:

* Changed
* Been modified
* Become corrupted
* Been replaced
* Remained identical

Perfect for backup verification, archive validation, and secure file distribution.

---

## Inventory Generation

Automatically build a complete inventory of your files.

The generated report includes information such as:

* File names
* File locations
* Extensions
* File sizes
* Folder hierarchy
* Hash values (optional)

Ideal for documentation, auditing, and asset management.

---

## Filesystem Statistics

Generate detailed statistics for folders and storage locations.

Analyze:

* Total files
* Folder count
* File types
* Storage usage
* Size distribution
* Extension distribution

Gain valuable insights before organizing or processing large collections.

---

## Flexible Scanning

Analyze exactly the files you need.

Features include:

* Single file analysis
* Multiple file analysis
* Entire folder analysis
* Recursive scanning
* Extension filtering

Supported file types include:

* Video
* Audio
* Images
* Documents
* General files

---

## Automation Ready

Media Analysis Engine integrates seamlessly with **Core Factory V2 Pipelines**.

Its structured reports can be passed directly to downstream engines such as:

* File Organization
* File Transfer
* Media Processing
* AI Analysis
* OCR
* Backup Automation
* Archive Management

This makes it an ideal first stage in automated workflows where decisions depend on file analysis.

---

# Typical Use Cases

* Detect duplicate media libraries
* Verify backup integrity
* Build AI dataset inventories
* Audit project folders
* Generate digital archive manifests
* Analyze storage usage
* Prepare files before migration
* Validate distributed content

---

# Reliable and Safe

Media Analysis Engine is designed to analyze files without unnecessary modification.

Features include:

* Read-only analysis modes
* Structured JSON reports
* Progress monitoring
* Cancellation support
* Worker-process execution
* Atomic report generation

Even when duplicate actions are enabled, the engine follows configurable policies to ensure predictable and controlled behavior.

---

# System Requirements

* Core Factory V2
* Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
* Local or accessible storage locations

No external services or cloud connections are required.

---

# Why Choose Media Analysis Engine?

Managing thousands of files without understanding what's inside often leads to duplicated storage, inconsistent backups, and inefficient workflows.

Media Analysis Engine provides the visibility you need before taking action. From duplicate detection and integrity verification to inventory generation and storage analysis, it helps you make informed decisions with confidence.

Whether you're organizing media, preparing AI datasets, auditing archives, or building enterprise automation pipelines, Media Analysis Engine delivers reliable, structured, and repeatable analysis every time.

---

## Perfect For

* Content Creators
* AI Developers
* Photographers
* Archivists
* IT Administrators
* Engineers
* Businesses
* Anyone managing large collections of files

Analyze first. Automate with confidence.

items.name: Media Aspect Convert Engine V2
items.title: Media Aspect Convert Engine V2
items.description:
# Media Aspect Convert Engine V2

**Convert any video to landscape, portrait, or square format with professional framing modes and batch automation.**

Media Aspect Convert Engine is a professional video processing engine for **Core Factory V2** that automatically converts videos between different aspect ratios while preserving visual quality.

Whether you're repurposing YouTube videos for TikTok, creating Instagram Reels from widescreen footage, preparing square videos for social media, or standardizing media libraries, this engine provides intelligent framing options that eliminate manual editing.

Built for automation, it supports recursive batch processing, multiple framing strategies, and seamless integration into Core Factory V2 Pipelines.

---

# Key Features

## Convert Between Popular Aspect Ratios

Quickly transform videos into the most commonly used formats.

Supported output formats:

* Landscape (1920 × 1080)
* Portrait (1080 × 1920)
* Square (1080 × 1080)

Perfect for adapting content across multiple social media platforms without recreating your videos from scratch.

---

## Multiple Framing Modes

Choose how your content should fit inside the new frame.

### Fit

Preserves the entire image with letterboxing or pillarboxing when necessary.

Ideal when no part of the original video should be cropped.

---

### Crop

Fills the entire frame by intelligently cropping excess areas.

Best for creating immersive full-screen content.

---

### Pan

Automatically animates the crop window to follow the image across the frame.

Ideal for converting landscape videos into engaging vertical content.

---

### Zoom

Applies controlled magnification to fill the target frame while keeping the subject prominent.

Great for social media shorts and close-up presentations.

---

### Blur Background

Creates a blurred version of the original video behind the main image.

A popular technique for converting widescreen videos into portrait or square formats while preserving all visual content.

---

## Flexible Position Control

Fine-tune how the visible area is aligned during framing.

Supported alignment:

* Left
* Center
* Right

This gives you more control over which part of the image remains visible after cropping or padding.

---

Automatically divide long videos or audio recordings into smaller segments.

* Batch splitting

* High-speed FFmpeg processing

Perfect for preparing content for social media, cloud uploads, archives, or downstream editing.

Combine multiple media files into one continuous output.

Merge all compatible media files inside each folder into a single output.

Ideal for project-based organization.

Combine every compatible media file from all selected folders into one final video.

Perfect for creating compilations or complete archives.

* Natural filename order
* Original filesystem order

Features include:

* Extension filtering

Designed for production-scale media libraries.

Features include:

* Automatic overwrite handling

* Processing logs

Every operation produces machine-readable results for downstream automation.

* Websites
* Channels
* Services
* Mobile apps

Display a modern information panel alongside the CTA video.

* Opacity control

Create clean promotional overlays that look natural instead of distracting.

* Bottom Left
* Bottom Right
* Video Only

Display your CTA exactly when it matters most.

Configure:

* Overlay start time

* Fade
* Slide Up

Animations improve viewer experience without disrupting the main content.

* Panel background color
* Panel transparency

* Bottom safe margin

* Overwrite control

items.description:
Workspace Plugin V2

Manage projects, reusable work libraries, and Excel-ready labour lists—all in one organized workspace.

Workspace Plugin is a professional productivity plugin for Core Factory V2, designed to centralize project management, technical documentation, reusable labour data, and quantity calculations into a single workspace.

Instead of juggling spreadsheets, folders, notes, and documents across multiple applications, Workspace Plugin gives you one structured environment where everything stays organized, reusable, and easy to manage.

Whether you're an engineer, contractor, content creator, technical team, or business owner, Workspace Plugin helps streamline daily operations while reducing repetitive work.

Key Features
Workspace Management

Create and organize multiple independent workspaces.

Each workspace can contain its own:

Tasks
Notes
Activities
Reminders
Attachments
Labour Data
Labour Lists

Keep every project isolated, organized, and easy to maintain.

Labour Data Library

Build reusable libraries of work items that can be used across unlimited projects.

Each Labour Data entry may include:

Item information
Descriptions
Images
Attachments
Structured tables
Materials
Labour quantities
Units of measurement

Create once and reuse whenever needed.

Labour List Builder

Generate complete labour or quantity lists by combining existing Labour Data.

Features include:

Select multiple labour templates
Reuse the same template multiple times
Quantity coefficient for each item
Automatic quantity multiplication
Automatic aggregation of duplicate rows
Live calculation preview

Perfect for construction estimates, engineering quantities, and repetitive project planning.

Excel Export

Export labour lists into clean, professional Excel spreadsheets.

Automatically generate:

Quantity summaries
Labour schedules
Material lists
Project reports

Reduce manual spreadsheet editing while improving consistency.

Task & Activity Management

Track work progress inside every workspace.

Features include:

Task management
Activity history
Notes
Reminders
Status tracking

Everything stays linked to the correct workspace for better organization.

File Attachments

Attach supporting documents directly to projects.

Supported examples include:

Drawings
Photos
PDFs
Office documents
Videos
Reference files

All attachments remain organized with the related workspace.

Automation Ready

Workspace Plugin integrates naturally with the Core Factory V2 ecosystem.

Generated Excel files and structured project data can be used alongside other plugins and automation pipelines, making it easy to extend your workflow as projects grow.

Typical Use Cases
Construction quantity takeoff
Bill of Quantities (BOQ)
Engineering project management
Installation planning
Technical documentation
Asset organization
Internal business operations
Reusable work libraries
Team collaboration
Why Choose Workspace Plugin?

Most projects rely on a mix of spreadsheets, folders, documents, and handwritten notes, making information difficult to maintain and reuse.

Workspace Plugin brings everything together in one structured system. Reusable labour libraries, automatic quantity calculations, Excel export, and organized project management help reduce repetitive work while improving consistency across every project.

Instead of rebuilding information every time, you build reusable assets that continue delivering value across future projects.

Perfect For
Engineers
Contractors
Construction Companies
Technical Teams
Manufacturing Businesses
Content Production Teams
Project Managers
Anyone managing structured work and reusable project data

Organize once. Reuse everywhere. Manage every project with confidence using Workspace Plugin V2.
